t: A ready-made boxed AI computer built on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX.
steps: Buy the box from Seeed Studio, DigiKey, or Mouser. Seeed lists it at 1,399 US dollars.
Get an AC power cord for the included 12 volt adapter. The cord is not in the box.
Connect an HDMI screen, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Turn it on and finish the Ubuntu setup screens.
Read the Seeed wiki page on JetPack for this model. Leave the MAXN SUPER mode turned off.
Try Seeed's jetson-examples repo from GitHub.
Plug in a USB webcam and run a live object detection example.
meta: Open Board. From $909. A few stores.
